findings.message: No accepted G3 evidence exists for the English inputs bound to this review. Both G3 rounds ended in disposition revise (specs/content/gnas-301/reviews/unit-05/G3/20260924T001055Z-g3-attempt-01.json, 5 blocking findings; specs/content/gnas-301/reviews/unit-05/G3/round-02/agent-g3-gnas301-u5-run002.json, 5 blocking findings: the 5.1 RRQ deficit, the PM2.5 claims, the fig-U5-3 arrows, the coverage U5-07 cell, the alibhatti2017 author list). The author applied the full repair set post-report and this G5 manifest binds the repaired state at b80bcc9, where 5 of 7 English unit files (docs/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-01.mdx..topic-04.mdx, unit-assessment.mdx) carry digests different from the G3 round-2 manifest. The G5 rubric requires accepted G3 evidence for the exact English inputs; a changed English digest invalidates the dependency. The third G3 cycle is owner-gated (specs/gaps.md G-2026-32, open; the same dependency question is already recorded for Units 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 in G-2026-24/31/32/33/34). The Urdu-side findings below stand on their own evidence and are preserved for the repair cycle; the dependency itself needs the curriculum owner to accept the repaired English state or authorise a third G3 cycle.

Negation reversed in the quoted misconception. EN docs/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-04.mdx:104 "International agreements are toothless talk shops" and EN docs/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-teacher-notes.mdx:41 "MEAs are toothless talk shops" are rendered "بین الاقوامی معاہدے دانت والی بات کرنے والی جگہیں ہیں" (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-04.mdx:60) and "ایم ای اے دانت والی بات کرنے والی جگہیں ہیں" (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-teacher-notes.mdx:29). "دانت والی" means "possessing teeth", the opposite of "toothless", so the quoted claim reads as "agreements are toothed talk shops"; the refutation that follows ("An MEA has no police, which is a real limit...") no longer answers the quoted claim coherently. Repair: "بے دانت" with a natural rendering of "talk shops" (e.g. "بے دانت باتوں کی محفلیں") in both files.

"Climate" is rendered as موسم/موسمی (season/seasonal) in the marking guidance and both governance figures, misnaming the subject of two MEAs and SDG 13. i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-assessment.mdx:152-153 gives the RRQ-10 model answers "ریو 1992 (موسم اور حیاتیاتی تنوع کنونشن)" and "پیرس 2015 (موسم)" (EN :180-181 "climate and biodiversity conventions" / "climate"); static/img/figures/gnas-301/unit-05/fig-U5-7.ur.svg labels Rio 1992 "موسم + حیاتیاتی تنوع کنونشن" and Paris 2015 "موسمی معاہدہ" (seasonal agreement); fig-U5-8.ur.svg labels "ایس ڈی جی 13 موسم" and "فوری موسمی کارروائی" (urgent seasonal action) for SDG 13 Climate Action. The unit prose itself uses the correct موسمیاتی (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-04.mdx:43,46,56), so a student meets two different words for climate, one of them wrong. Repair: موسمیاتی in all five loci.

The unit core concept "detoxification" is rendered "صاف کرنا" (to clean) throughout the Urdu prose while the Urdu figure variants and the concept graph use the transliteration "ڈی ٹاکسیفیکیشن", with no bridge between them. Prose loci: i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/index.mdx:9,27,28; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-02.mdx:2,3,30,38,43,45,63; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-03.mdx (title, :30,41,45,47,62); i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-assessment.mdx:22,70,100. Figure/concept loci: fig-U5-3.ur.svg ("ڈی ٹاکسیفیکیشن (عام)"), fig-U5-4.ur.svg (title), fig-U5-5.ur.svg, fig-U5-6.ur.svg; specs/content/gnas-301/concepts/unit-05.md:19-20,36-37. A reader who cannot read English cannot know the two are the same term; "صاف کرنا" also collides with the marketing "cleanse" vocabulary the topic argues against ("جگر صاف" tea, i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-03.mdx:24,47) and with waste treatment (فضلہ صاف کرنا, i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-02.mdx:26). Same defect class as Unit 4 G5 blocking finding 6. Repair: adopt one term (ڈی ٹاکسیفیکیشن or زہر ربائی) across prose, figures and the concept graph, or gloss the plain verb with the technical term at first use.

fig-U5-1.ur.svg carries invalid y attributes: all 10 second-line stage labels use y="130+0" or y="130+20" (literal arithmetic strings, not SVG lengths). Chromium parses no y value for them (text.y.baseVal empty; see specs/content/gnas-301/reviews/unit-05/G5/renders-20260924T081245Z/check-y-attr.txt) and renders them at y=0, clipped at the figure top edge, so the five stage panels show only their headings (specs/content/gnas-301/reviews/unit-05/G5/renders-20260924T081245Z/ur-figure-measurements.json: 10 clipped texts at y=-12 and 5 overlapping pairs). The identical defect exists in all four variants (fig-U5-1.svg, .dark.svg, .ur.svg, .ur.dark.svg), so it originates in the English figure and was not caught by G3 rounds 1-2; the Urdu variant is equally unusable. Repair: y="130" / y="150" in all four files.

Platform RTL alignment defect, production-confirmed. The Urdu build stylesheet contains "html[dir=rtl] .markdown{line-height:2.2;text-align:left}" (build/ur/assets/css/styles.161fd4ec.css; the same rule is live at textbook.com.pk, fetched 2026-09-24) because Docusaurus's RTL CSS pass flips the manually authored text-align:right in src/css/custom.css:49-52. Rendered Urdu headings and short/last lines anchor to the physical left edge (measured: first h2 text at elemLeft with ~196px empty to its right; synthetic probe left-anchored; CDP matched rules show the flipped declaration), inverting the intended RTL typography on every Urdu page site-wide. Not a translation defect of this unit; needs a platform fix (logical property text-align:start, or exclusion from the RTL flip) and a rebuild. Evidence: specs/content/gnas-301/reviews/unit-05/G5/renders-20260924T081245Z/rtl-alignment-defect.txt.

EN docs/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-02.mdx:111-112 "note the door of absorption a spill would use" is rendered "وہ جذب کا دروازہ نوٹ کریں جو کوئی اخراج استعمال کرے گا" (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-02.mdx:74): "spill" becomes "اخراج", which is this unit's own stage-4 term for "excretion" (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-02.mdx:39 "اخراج یا ذخیرہ"), so the practicum instruction reads "note the absorption door that an excretion would use" - a confusing technical statement that collides with the journey vocabulary the students just learned. Repair: render "spill" as "انڈیلنے/بہنے والا کیمیکل".

"واقفیت" (acquaintance/familiarity) is the prose term for "exposure/exposed" (e.g. "کون واقف ہے" for "who is exposed" and "بار بار واقفیت" for "repeated exposure": i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-03.mdx:41; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-04.mdx:33,93; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-assessment.mdx:38,117,130,147). In standard Urdu it means familiarity, and fig-U5-5.ur.svg instead uses "رابطہ" for the same concept, so the term is both misleading and internally inconsistent. Same class as Unit 4 G5 advisory finding 7 (advisory there too). Owner term decision needed (e.g. تعریض or a glossed loanword); the bank is not edited from here.

"Trainee teacher" is rendered "تربیت یافتہ استاد" (trained teacher), reversing the actor's status: i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-03.mdx:24 (with the internally contradictory "تربیت یافتہ نے ابھی سیکھا ہے" - a trained teacher who has just learned), i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-04.mdx:25,56,72 ("تربیت یافتہ کے سوال"). The B.Ed audience identification (a trainee applying fresh learning) is lost. Repair: "زیرِ تربیت استاد".

Arsenic is misspelled "آرینک" 12 times in this unit (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-01.mdx:44,59,63; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-04.mdx:33,58,93; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-assessment.mdx:40,117,126,171; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-teacher-notes.mdx:18). The standard spelling is "آرسینک", which GNAS-301 Unit 2 already uses (i18n/ur/.../unit-02/topic-02.mdx:41), so the course is internally inconsistent as well. Repair: "آرسینک" throughout.

Bloom tag "Evaluate" is split across the unit: item tags use "جانچیں" (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-assessment.mdx:114-118; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-03.mdx:58) but rubric rows use "تشخیص" (i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-03.mdx:87; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/topic-04.mdx:100; i18n/ur/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/current/semester-1/gnas-301/unit-05/unit-assessment.mdx:165-172), and "تشخیص" is the banked term for Assessment (specs/content/terminology.csv:19), creating a vocabulary collision; the same split exists in Unit 4, so it is course-wide. Relatedly, bare "Assessment" in the page title "یونٹ 5 کا جائزہ" drifts from the banked تشخیص (جائزہ is accepted inside the banked summative compounds, which "مجموعی جائزہ" at :24 correctly is).

Further prose/figure terminology drift on core terms (repair list for the owner): multilateral "کثیر الجہتی" (prose) vs "کثیر الفریقی" (fig-U5-7.ur.svg; concepts/unit-05.md:22,39); concentration "ارتکاز" (prose) vs "حراستی" (fig-U5-1.ur.svg); targets/indicators "ہدف/اشاریے" (prose) vs "نشان/پیمانہ" (fig-U5-8.ur.svg); organophosphate "آرگنو فاسفیٹ" (prose) vs "نامیاتی فاسفیٹ" (fig-U5-4.ur.svg); worked example "حل شدہ مثال" (prose) vs "حلیہ مثال" (fig-U5-1.ur.svg; حلیہ means disguise); handle "ہینڈل" (prose) vs "دستہ" (fig-U5-5.ur.svg); risk "رسک" (prose) vs "خطرے" (concepts/unit-05.md:21) while the prose reserves "خطرہ" for hazard; sprayer "سپرے والا" vs "چھڑکنے والا"; natural "قدرتی" (prose) vs "قدری" (fig-U5-5/6.ur.svg titles; concepts :20,37 - قدری is not the standard word for natural).

fig-U5-4.ur.svg geometry: the detoxification row's example cell "CO صاف ہوا میں سانس سے باہر" overlaps the risk label "وقت لیتا ہے" by 43x17px and the cell carries a duplicated leftover fragment "صاف ہوا میں" (EN has two lines "CO breathed back out" / "in clean air"); slight overlap also between "ایک نامیاتی فاسفیٹ بدل کر" and "نقصان لیبل سے آگے" (11x16). The EN variant has its own header overlap ("One worked example" over "The risk", 40x18px) - noted for the owner as an English-side defect.
